abilities.text:
When an NPC accompanies you on your adventures they become a companion.

Companions have an endurance meter. When your companion takes damage, make the [Companion Takes a Hit](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/companion_takes_a_hit) to determine the outcome. If your companion's endurance is reduced to 0, or was already at 0 and your Companion takes a hit, you must Lose momentum and apply any remaining -endurance to your momentum meter.

When your companion's endurance is at 0 and you score a miss, they are out of action. You cannot leverage their support until they gain at least +1 endurance. If you score a miss with a match, they're dead.

abilities.name: In darkness they feast
abilities.text: When you [Undertake an Expedition](datasworn:move:revenant/exploration/undertake_an_expedition) or [Journey](datasworn:move:revenant/exploration/journey) and roll a 1 on your action die, start a scene challenge as you try to survive the night.

abilities.name: Oh Rats
abilities.text: If you [Endure Harm](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/endure_harm) from a rat, mark the __wounded__ impact.

abilities.name: Like the plague
abilities.text: Rats are capable of transmitting the Revenant pathogen. You must [Avoid Being Bitten](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/avoid_being_bitten) when fighting rats.
You are immune to the Revenant pathogen. If you need to [Avoid Being Bitten](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/avoid_being_bitten), consider it an automatic strong hit.

clock.label: notable foe or force tracks you down

abilities.text: You are hunted by a power or authority. When you make a move, you may improve the result to a strong hit. If you do, fill one segment of a four-segment clock to represent hunters closing in. When the clock is filled, a notable foe or force has tracked you down. If you overcome them or escape, reset the clock and mark 1 tick on your plans legacy track.

abilities.name: Just a scratch
abilities.text: When you [Avoid Being Bitten](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/avoid_being_bitten) and miss, roll your action die. You only [Face Death](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/face_death) if the action die is a 1.

abilities.name: Infectious
abilities.text: When you [Avoid Being Bitten](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/avoid_being_bitten), count a weak hit as a miss.

abilities.name: Black Fever
abilities.text: When you [Avoid Being Bitten](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/avoid_being_bitten) and miss, start a scene challenge. This scene challenge will determine how you attempt to overcome the black fever. Only [Face Death](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/face_death) if you [Finish the Scene](datasworn:move:revenant/scene_challenge/finish_the_scene) and miss.

Envision the type of vehicle and assign a maximum integrity as follow:
  * Heavy: 5 integrity
  * Medium: 4 integrity
  * Light: 3 integrity

__Battered__ may be marked when your vehicle is at 0 integrity and you fail to [Withstand Damage](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/withstand_damage).

Vehicle troubles are linked to a specific vehicle and are only a factor when you are piloting or aboard that vehicle. Otherwise, they do not count as an impact or affect your momentum.

The battered impact can be cleared when you successfully [Repair](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/repair) the vehicle. Until you do so, you cannot raise the vehicle's integrity.

aid_your_ally.name: Aid Your Ally
aid_your_ally.text:
__When you act in direct support of an ally__, envision how you aid them. Then, [Secure an Advantage](datasworn:move:revenant/basic/secure_an_advantage), [Obtain an Opportunity](datasworn:move:revenant/scene_challenge/obtain_an_opportunity), or [Gain Ground](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/gain_ground) to take action. If you score a hit, they (instead of you) take the benefits of the move.

If you [Gain Ground](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/gain_ground) and score a __strong hit__, you both have the upper hand. On a __weak hit__, your ally has the upper hand but you are in a bad spot.

trigger.text: When you act in direct support of an ally...

check_your_gear.name: Check Your Gear

miss.text: On a __miss__, you don't have it and the situation becomes dire. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you have it, and are ready to act. Take +1 momentum.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you have it, but must choose one.

  * Your supply is diminished: [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) (-1)
  * It's not quite right, and causes a complication or delay: [Lose Momentum](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/lose_momentum) (-2)

check_your_gear.text:
__When you check to see if you have a specific helpful item or resource__, roll +supply.

On a __strong hit__, you have it, and are ready to act. Take +1 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, you have it, but must choose one.

  * Your supply is diminished: [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) (-1)
  * It's not quite right, and causes a complication or delay: [Lose Momentum](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/lose_momentum) (-2)

On a __miss__, you don't have it and the situation becomes dire. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you check to see if you have a specific helpful item or resource...

compel.name: Compel

miss.text: On a __miss__, they refuse or make a demand that costs you greatly. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, they'll do what you want or agree to your conditions. Take +1 momentum.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, they'll do what you want or agree to your conditions, but their agreement comes with a demand or complication. Envision their counteroffer and take +1 momentum.

compel.text:
__When you try to persuade someone or make them an offer__, envision your approach. If you...

  * Charm, pacify, encourage, or barter: Roll +heart
  * Threaten or incite: Roll +iron
  * Lie or swindle: Roll +dark

On a __strong hit__, they'll do what you want or agree to your conditions. Take +1 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but their agreement comes with a demand or complication. Envision their counteroffer.

On a __miss__, they refuse or make a demand that costs you greatly. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you try to persuade someone or make them an offer...

defy_danger.name: Defy Danger

miss.text: On a __miss__, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dire turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you are successful. Take +1 momentum.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you succeed, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1).

defy_danger.text:
__When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat__, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  * With finesse, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
  * With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
  * With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
  * With deception, stealth, or betrayal: Roll +dark
  * With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

On a __strong hit__, you are successful. Take +1 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, you succeed, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1).

On a __miss__, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dire turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat...

gather_information.name: Gather Information

miss.text: On a __miss__, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn. Then, take +2 momentum.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, the information provides new insight, but also complicates your quest. Envision what you discover. Then, take +1 momentum.

gather_information.text:
__When you conduct an investigation, ask questions, do research, or search an area for clues__, roll +wits.

On a __strong hit__, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn. Then, take +2 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, the information provides new insight, but also complicates your quest. Envision what you discover. Then, take +1 momentum.

On a __miss__, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you conduct an investigation, ask questions, do research, or search an area for clues...

secure_an_advantage.name: Secure an Advantage

miss.text: On a __miss__, you fail or your assumptions betray you. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you succeed. Take +2 momentum. Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move).

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you succeed. Choose one.

  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

secure_an_advantage.text:
__When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage__, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  * With finesse, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
  * With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
  * With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
  * With deception, stealth, or betrayal: Roll +dark
  * With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

On a __hit__, you succeed. On a __strong hit__, take both. On a __weak hit__, choose one.

  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

On a __miss__, you fail or your assumptions betray you. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage...

basic.description: The __Basic Moves__ encompass broadly useful actions to overcome obstacles, reinforce your position, conduct investigations, influence others, and support your fellow allies. When you face peril or try to gain leverage and another move does not apply, you'll likely find your answer among these moves.
basic.name: Basic Moves
basic.summary: __Basic moves__ cover a variety of common situations but are generally unrelated. They may trigger at any time.

avoid_being_bitten.name: Avoid Being Bitten

miss.text: On a __miss__, you get bitten and must immediately [Face Death](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/face_death).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. You gain the upper hand and may immediately [Take Decisive Action](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/take_decisive_action). If you do you may reroll your challenge dice.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you avoid begin bitten, but it is stressful. [Endure Stress](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/endure_stress) (-2) and you are in a bad spot.

avoid_being_bitten.text:
__When you are in close quarters combat with a creature capable of transmitting the Revenant pathogen__ and roll a 1 on your action die when you make a suffer move, roll your challenge dice and compare to your momentum.

If you have the upper hand, check the result as normal. If you are in a bad spot, count a strong hit without a match as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss.

On a __strong hit__, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. You gain the upper hand and may immediately [Take Decisive Action](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/take_decisive_action). If you do you may reroll your challenge dice.

On a __weak hit__, you avoid begin bitten, but it is stressful. [Endure Stress](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/endure_stress) (-2) and you are in a bad spot.

On a __miss__, you get bitten and must immediately [Face Death](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/face_death).

trigger.text: When you are in close quarters combat with a creature capable of transmitting the Revenant pathogen...

clash.name: Clash

miss.text: On a __miss__, your foe dominates this exchange. You stay in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, mark progress twice. You overwhelm your foe and gain the upper hand.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, mark progress, but you are dealt a counterblow or setback. You stay in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

clash.text:
__When you are in a bad spot and fight back against a foe at close quarters__, roll +iron; __when you return fire at a distance__, roll +edge.

On a __strong hit__, mark progress twice. You overwhelm your foe and gain the upper hand.

On a __weak hit__, mark progress, but you are dealt a counterblow or setback. You stay in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

On a __miss__, your foe dominates this exchange. You stay in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

conditions.text: Fight back against a foe at close quarters

trigger.text: When you are in a bad spot and fight back against a foe at close quarters, or when you return fire at a distance...

enter_the_fray.name: Enter the Fray

miss.text: On a __miss__, the fight begins with you in a bad spot.

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, take +2 momentum. You have the upper hand.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, choose one.

  * Take +2 momentum
  * You have the upper hand

enter_the_fray.text:
__When you initiate combat or are forced into a fight__, envision your objective and give it a rank. If the combat includes discrete challenges or phases, set an objective with a rank for each.

Then, roll to determine your position. If you are...

  * On the move: Roll +edge
  * Facing off against your foe: Roll +heart
  * In the thick of it at close quarters: Roll +iron
  * Preparing to act against an unaware foe: Roll +dark
  * Caught in a trap or sizing up the situation: Roll +wits

On a __strong hit__, take both. On a __weak hit__, choose one.

  * Take +2 momentum
  * You have the upper hand

On a __miss__, the fight begins with you in a bad spot.

conditions.text: In the thick of it at close quarters
Preparing to act against an unaware foe
Caught in a trap or sizing up the situation

trigger.text: When you initiate combat or are forced into a fight...

face_defeat.name: Face Defeat
face_defeat.text:
__When you abandon or are deprived of an objective__, envision the consequence of this failure, clear the objective, and [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

If the fight continues, you may create a new objective and give it a rank to represent the changing situation. If any objectives remain, the fight continues and you are in a bad spot.

trigger.text: When you abandon or are deprived of an objective...

gain_ground.name: Gain Ground

miss.text: On a __miss__, your foe gains control, the fight moves to a new location, or you encounter a new peril. You are in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text:
On a __strong hit__, you stay in control. Choose two.

  * Mark progress
  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you stay in control. Choose one.

  * Mark progress
  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

gain_ground.text:
__When you have the upper hand and take action in a fight to reinforce your position or move toward an objective__, envision your approach and roll. If you are...

  * In pursuit, fleeing, or maneuvering: Roll +edge
  * Coming to the aid of others, or commanding: Roll +heart
  * Gaining leverage with force, or making a threat: Roll +iron
  * Hiding, preparing an ambush, or misdirecting: Roll +dark
  * Coordinating a plan, or studying a situation: Roll +wits

On a __hit__, you stay in control. On a __strong hit__, choose two. On a __weak hit__, choose one.

  * Mark progress
  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

On a __miss__, your foe gains control, the fight moves to a new location, or you encounter a new peril. You are in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

conditions.text: Coming to the aid of others, or commanding
Gaining leverage with force, or making a threat
Hiding, preparing an ambush, or misdirecting
Coordinating a plan, or studying a situation

trigger.text: When you have the upper hand and take action in a fight to reinforce your position or move toward an objective...

react_under_fire.name: React Under Fire

miss.text: On a __miss__, the situation worsens. You stay in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you succeed and gain the upper hand. Take +1 momentum.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you avoid the worst of the danger or overcome the obstacle, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1). You stay in a bad spot.

react_under_fire.text:
__When you are in a bad spot and take action in a fight to avoid danger or overcome an obstacle__, envision your approach and roll. If you are...

  * In pursuit, fleeing, dodging, or taking cover: Roll +edge
  * Remaining stalwart against fear or temptation: Roll +heart
  * Blocking or diverting with force, or taking the hit: Roll +iron
  * Moving into hiding or creating a distraction: Roll +dark
  * Changing the plan, or bypassing an obstacle: Roll +wits

On a __strong hit__, you succeed and gain the upper hand. Take +1 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, you avoid the worst of the danger or overcome the obstacle, but not without a cost. Make a suffer move (-1). You stay in a bad spot.

On a __miss__, the situation worsens. You stay in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

conditions.text: In pursuit, fleeing, dodging, or taking cover
Remaining stalwart against fear or temptation
Blocking or diverting with force, or taking the hit
Moving into hiding or creating a distraction
Changing the plan, or bypassing an obstacle

trigger.text: When you are in a bad spot and take action in a fight to avoid danger or overcome an obstacle...

reload.name: Reload

miss.text: On a __miss__, you have no more ammunition for this weapon. If you are in combat, you are in a bad spot. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you are well stocked and reload your weapon easily. If you are in combat, you have the upper hand.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you reload your empty weapon, but your supply is running low. [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) (-1). If you are in combat, you are in a bad spot.

reload.text:
__If you shoot a firearm__ and roll a 1 on your action die, you have used your last round. If you have the unprepared impact marked, you have run out of ammunition. Otherwise, to reload, roll +supply.

On a __strong hit__, you are well stocked and reload your weapon easily. If you are in combat, you have the upper hand.

On a __weak hit__, you reload your empty weapon, but your supply is running low. [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) (-1). If you are in combat, you are in a bad spot.

On a __miss__, you have no more ammunition for this weapon. If you are in combat, you are in a bad spot. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: If you shoot a firearm...

strike.name: Strike

miss.text: On a __miss__, the fight turns against you. You are in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, mark progress twice. You dominate your foe and retain the upper hand.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, mark progress twice, but you expose yourself to danger. You are in a bad spot.

strike.text:
__When you have the upper hand and assault a foe at close quarters__, roll +iron; __when you attack at a distance__, roll +edge.

On a __strong hit__, mark progress twice. You dominate your foe and retain the upper hand.

On a __weak hit__, mark progress twice, but you expose yourself to danger. You are in a bad spot.

On a __miss__, the fight turns against you. You are in a bad spot and must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

conditions.text: Assault a foe at close quarters

trigger.text: When you have the upper hand and assault a foe at close quarters, or when you attack at a distance...

take_decisive_action.name: Take Decisive Action

rows.text: It's worse than you thought: Make a suffer move (-2)
Victory is short-lived: A new hazard or foe appears
You face collateral damage: Something of value is lost
Others pay the price: Someone else meets with disaster
Others won't forget: You are marked for vengeance
It gets complicated: The nature of a foe or goal is revealed

miss.text: On a __miss__, you are defeated or fail your objective. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. If any objectives remain and the fight continues, you gain or retain the upper hand.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Roll on the table below or choose one. If the fight continues, you are in a bad spot.

take_decisive_action.text:
__When you seize an objective in a fight__, envision how you take decisive action. Then, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

If you have the upper hand, check the result as normal. If you are in a bad spot, count a strong hit without a match as a weak hit, and a weak hit as a miss.

On a __strong hit__, you prevail. Take +1 momentum. If any objectives remain and the fight continues, you gain or retain the upper hand.

On a __weak hit__, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Roll on the table below or choose one. If the fight continues, you are in a bad spot.

combat.description:
The world is a dangerous place. Nomadic warriors prey on vulnerable travellers. Rival enclaves raid each other's settlements. Exotic creatures escaped from zoos stalk the unwary. The living dead wander battle-torn cities and hordes gather in the countryside.

When you face one or more foes in high-stakes, action-oriented  conflict, use the __combat moves__. These moves encompass on-foot action and vehicle sorties—or both as part of the same challenge.
combat.name: Combat Moves
combat.summary: __Combat moves__ are used when fighting (but not exclusively; other moves may come into play as well).

develop_your_relationship.name: Develop Your Relationship

miss.text: On a __miss__, take no lasting benefit.

strong_hit.text:
On a __strong hit__, mark 2 ticks on your bonds legacy track.

On a __strong hit with a match__, you may also envision how recent events bolstered your connection's standing and raise their rank by one (if not already epic).

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, take +2 momentum.

develop_your_relationship.text:
__When you reinforce your relationship with a connection__ by doing any of the following...

  * making a plan to undertake a plan in their service
  * completing a plan to their benefit
  * leveraging their help in desperate circumstances
  * giving them something of worth
  * sharing a profound moment
  * standing with them against hardship
  * overcoming a test of your relationship

...you may mark progress per the rank of the connection.

If you already share a bond with the connection, do not mark progress. Instead, roll +their rank to learn the impact on your legacy: troublesome=+1; dangerous=+2; formidable=+3; extreme=+4; epic=+5.

On a __strong hit__, mark 2 ticks on your bonds legacy track.

On a __strong hit with a match__, you may also envision how recent events bolstered your connection's standing and raise their rank by one (if not already epic).

On a __weak hit__, take +2 momentum.

On a __miss__, take no lasting benefit.

conditions.text: If you already share a bond with the connection

trigger.text: When you reinforce your relationship with a connection...

forge_a_bond.name: Forge a Bond

miss.text: On a __miss__, they reveal something that fundamentally alters or undermines your relationship. If you recommit to this relationship, roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the connection's rank by one (if not already epic).

strong_hit.text:
On a __strong hit__, you now share a bond. Mark a reward on your bonds legacy track per the connection's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who share this connection also mark the reward.

When a connection with whom you share a bond aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +2 instead of the usual +1.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, they ask something more of you first. To gain the bond and the legacy reward, envision the nature of the request, and do it (or [Make a Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/make_a_plan) to see it done).

If you do, you now share a bond. Mark a reward on your bonds legacy track per the connection's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who share this connection also mark the reward.

When a connection with whom you share a bond aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +2 instead of the usual +1.

forge_a_bond.text:
__When your relationship with a connection is ready to mature__, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a __strong hit__, you now share a bond. Mark a reward on your bonds legacy track per the connection's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who share this connection also mark the reward.

When a connection with whom you share a bond aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +2 instead of the usual +1.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but they ask something more of you first. To gain the bond and the legacy reward, envision the nature of the request, and do it (or [Make a Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/make_a_plan) to see it done).

On a __miss__, they reveal something that fundamentally alters or undermines your relationship. If you recommit to this relationship, roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the connection's rank by one (if not already epic).

trigger.text: When your relationship with a connection is ready to mature...

make_a_connection.name: Make a Connection

miss.text: On a __miss__, you don't make a connection and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you create a connection. Give them a role and rank. Whenever your connection aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you create a connection, but it comes with a complication or cost. Envision what they reveal or demand.

Give the connection a role and rank. Whenever your connection aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.

make_a_connection.text:
__When you search out a new relationship or give focus to an existing relationship (not an ally)__, roll +heart.

On a __strong hit__, you create a connection. Give them a role and rank. Whenever your connection aids you on a move closely associated with their role, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but this connection comes with a complication or cost. Envision what they reveal or demand.

On a __miss__, you don't make a connection and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you search out a new relationship or give focus to an existing relationship (not an ally)...

rise_to_the_challenge.name: Rise to the Challenge
rise_to_the_challenge.text:
__When a connection takes up the mantle__ of being a player character, if you share a bond, you may create a new character and begin play as that connection.

When you choose your talents, consider what skills are related to the connections role.

connection.description:
__Connections__ are NPCs (non-player characters) who represent a deep, vital, or interesting relationship in your story. They are not your allies (protagonists portrayed by other players). Instead, connections are characters who are independent of you, but whose lives occasionally intersect with your own.

Connections provide story hooks and support you within the scope of their role. They usually represent positive relationships, but not always; a connection might instead be a rival or someone who wields power over you.

Make these __connection moves__ when you introduce connections and as you build influence or understanding with them.

  * [Abandon Your Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/abandon_your_plan).
  * Recommit to the plan: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the plan's rank by one (if not already epic).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, your plan is complete. Mark a reward on your plans legacy track per the plan's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who shared this plan also mark the reward.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, your plan is complete, but there is more to be done or you realize a fault in your plan. If you [Make a Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/make_a_plan) to set things right, take your full legacy reward per the plan's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Otherwise, make the reward one rank lower (none for a troublesome plan). Any allies who shared this vow also mark the reward.

accomplish_your_plan.text:
__When you reach the end of your plan__, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a __strong hit__, your plan is complete. Mark a reward on your plans legacy track per the plan's rank: troublesome=1 tick; dangerous=2 ticks; formidable=1 box; extreme=2 boxes; epic=3 boxes. Any allies who shared this plan also mark the reward.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but there is more to be done or you realize a fault in your plan. If you [Make a Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/make_a_plan) to set things right, take your full legacy reward. Otherwise, make the reward one rank lower (none for a troublesome plan).

On a __miss__, your plan is undone through an unexpected complication or a significant flaw or resource requirement that causes hardship. Envision what happens and choose one.

  * [Abandon Your Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/abandon_your_plan).
  * Recommit to the plan: Roll both challenge dice, take the lowest value, and clear that number of progress boxes. Then, raise the plan's rank by one (if not already epic).

trigger.text: When you reach the end of your plan...

advance_a_nemesis.name: Advance a Nemesis

rows.text: The Nemesis works subtly to advance toward its goal, or the danger escalates. This may include scenes outside of the characters perspective. Mark menace.

The Nemesis readies its next step, or a new danger looms. If you are in a position to prevent this development, you may attempt to do so. If you succeed, [Reach a Milestone](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/reach_a_milestone). Otherwise, mark menace.
The Nemesis makes a dramatic and immediate move, or a major event reveals new complications. Mark menace twice.

advance_a_nemesis.text:
__When you give ground to a Nemesis through inaction, failure, or delay__, roll on the table below and envision how the change manifests in your world.

{{table>move.oracle_rollable:revenant/plan/advance_a_nemesis.advance_a_nemesis}}

On a match, this development also exposes a surprising aspect of the Nemesis' plan or nature.

__If you fill the last circle on the Nemesis' menace track__, they achieve their goal, or the final dire outcome occurs. You must [Abandon your plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/abandon_your_plan).

trigger.text: When you give ground to a Nemesis through inaction, failure, or delay...

leverage_a_plan.name: Leverage a Plan
leverage_a_plan.text:
__When you make use of a plan you have successfully completed__, and you need to roll for a move, you may (decide before rolling) choose one.
  * Rely on experience: Roll +the rank of the plan, instead of rolling +stat.
  * Take command: Take +momentum equal to the rank of the plan on a strong hit.

On a __strong hit with a match__, you may also envision how recent events or leveraging this plan has enhanced it and raise its rank by one (if not already epic).

On a __miss with a match__, envision the impact of this failure. Until you successfully Repair it, take no benefit from this plan. Or, if you have no interest in retaining this plan, clear the plan.

trigger.text: When you make use of a plan you have successfully completed...

make_a_plan.name: Make a Plan

miss.text: On a __miss__, you must overcome a significant obstacle before you begin your plan. Envision what stands in your way.

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you are emboldened and it is clear what you must do next. Take +2 momentum.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you are determined but begin your plan with more questions than answers. Take +1 momentum, and envision what you do to find a path forward.

make_a_plan.text:
__When you aim to undertake a task__, give your plan a name and a rank. Then, roll +heart or +wits, whichever is higher.

If you make this plan to aid a connection, add +1; if you share a bond, add +2.

On a __strong hit__, you are emboldened and it is clear what you must do next. Take +2 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, you are determined but begin your plan with more questions than answers. Take +1 momentum, and envision what you do to find a path forward.

On a __miss__, you must overcome a significant obstacle before you begin your plan. Envision what stands in your way.

trigger.text: When you aim to undertake a task...

reach_a_milestone.name: Reach a Milestone
reach_a_milestone.text:
__When your actions benefit a plan__ by doing any of the following...

  * overcoming a critical obstacle
  * gaining meaningful insight
  * completing a perilous expedition
  * acquiring a crucial item or resource
  * earning vital support
  * defeating a notable foe

...you may mark progress per the rank of the plan.

trigger.text: When your actions benefit a plan...

take_a_hiatus.name: Take a Hiatus
take_a_hiatus.text:
When __you spend an extended time recovering in a safe place while a Nemesis is active__, do any of the following.

  * Clear any marked impacts.
  * Set your endurance, morale, supply, and radiation (if used) to +5.
  * Set your companion's endurance to +5.
  * Set your momentum to its reset value.

Then, for each active Nemesis, [Advance a Nemesis](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/advance_a_nemesis).

trigger.text: When you spend an extended time recovering in a safe place while a Nemesis is active...

plan.description:
In *Revenant*, the people with the plans are the ones who change the world. Plans can be made to yourself, as a representation of your personal commitment, or they can be made in service to someone else. Some plans might be made grudgingly - out of duty or necessity. Others will be made with your entire conviction.

Make these __Plan Moves__ when you make plans, make progress on your plans, when your plan comes to an end, and when you make use of those plans that you achieved.
plan.name: Plan Moves
plan.summary: __Plan moves__ encompass making plans, including making progress in a plan and resolving the outcome of a plan. It also includes the rules for when a Nemesis arises and their effect on your character.

heal.name: Heal

miss.text: On a __miss__, the aid is ineffective and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, the care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) are wounded, clear the impact and take or give +2 endurance. Otherwise, take or give +3 endurance.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, the care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) are wounded, clear the impact and take or give +2 endurance. Otherwise, take or give +3 endurance.

However, the recovery expends medicine or medical treatment. [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) (-1).

heal.text:
__When you receive medical care or provide treatment__, envision the situation and roll. If you...

  * Receive treatment from someone (not an ally): Roll +iron
  * Care for yourself: Roll +iron or +supply, whichever is lower
  * Provide care: Roll +wits or +supply, whichever is lower
  * Obtain treatment for a companion: Roll +heart

On a __strong hit__, the care is helpful. If you (or the ally under your care) are wounded, clear the impact and take or give +2 endurance. Otherwise, take or give +3 endurance.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but the recovery expends medicine or medical treatment. [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) (-1).

On a __miss__, the aid is ineffective and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

conditions.text: Receive treatment from someone (not an ally)

trigger.text: When you receive medical care or provide treatment...

hearten.name: Hearten

miss.text: On a __miss__, you take no comfort and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you find companionship or comfort and your spirit is strengthened. If you are shaken, clear the impact and take +1 morale. Otherwise, take +2 morale. If you make this move as you [Sojourn](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/sojourn), take +1 more.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you find companionship or comfort and your spirit is strengthened. If you are shaken, clear the impact and take +1 morale. Otherwise, take +2 morale. If you make this move as you [Sojourn](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/sojourn), take +1 more.

However, this respite is fleeting. Envision an interruption, complication, or inner conflict. Then, [Lose Momentum](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/lose_momentum) (-1).

hearten.text:
__When you socialize, share intimacy, or find a moment of peace__, roll +heart. If you do so in the presence of a connection, add +1. If you share a bond, add +2 instead.

On a __strong hit__, you find companionship or comfort and your spirit is strengthened. If you are shaken, clear the impact and take +1 morale. Otherwise, take +2 morale. If you make this move as you [Sojourn](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/sojourn), take +1 more.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but this respite is fleeting. Envision an interruption, complication, or inner conflict. Then, [Lose Momentum](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/lose_momentum) (-1).

On a __miss__, you take no comfort and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you socialize, share intimacy, or find a moment of peace...

repair.name: Repair

miss.text: On a __miss__, the repairs are not made and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text:
On a __strong hit__, you gain repair points as appropriate to the situation, per the table below.

Situation     | Strong Hit
--------------|-----------
At a facility | 5 points
In the field  | 3 points
Under fire    | 2 points

Additionally, you may [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) and exchange each -1 of your supply for 1 extra repair point (up to 3 points).

Spend repair points as follows. Unused points are discarded.

  * Clear the battered impact on a vehicle: 2 points
  * Fix one broken module: 2 points
  * Take +1 integrity on a vehicle: 1 point
  * Take +1 endurance for a mechanical companion: 1 point
  * Repair any other device: 3 points
  * Repair any other device, but with a complication or malfunction: 2 points

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you gain repair points as appropriate to the situation, per the table below.

Situation     | Weak Hit
--------------|---------
At a facility | 3 points
In the field  | 1 points
Under fire    | 0 points

Additionally, you may [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) and exchange each -1 of your supply for 1 extra repair point (up to 3 points).

Spend repair points as follows. Unused points are discarded.

  * Clear the battered impact on a vehicle: 2 points
  * Fix one broken module: 2 points
  * Take +1 integrity on a vehicle: 1 point
  * Take +1 endurance for a mechanical companion: 1 point
  * Repair any other device: 3 points
  * Repair any other device, but with a complication or malfunction: 2 points

repair.text:
__When you make repairs to your vehicles or other mechanical devices__, envision the situation and roll. If you...

  * Make your own repairs, or aid a connection to make repairs: Roll +supply or +wits, whichever is higher.
  * Obtain repairs from someone (not an ally): Roll +supply

On a __hit__, you gain repair points as appropriate to the situation, per the table below. Additionally, you may [Sacrifice Resources](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/sacrifice_resources) and exchange each -1 of your supply for 1 extra repair point (up to 3 points).

Situation     | Strong Hit | Weak Hit
--------------|------------|---------
At a facility | 5 points   | 3 points
In the field  | 3 points   | 1 points
Under fire    | 2 points   | 0 points

Spend repair points as follows. Unused points are discarded.

  * Clear the battered impact on a vehicle: 2 points
  * Take +1 integrity on a vehicle: 1 point
  * Install or repair a vehicle upgrade: 3 points
  * Repair any other device: 3 points
  * Repair any other device, but with a complication or malfunction: 2 points

On a __miss__, the repairs are not made and the situation worsens. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

conditions.text: Make your own repairs, or direct a companion to make repairs
Obtain repairs from someone (not an ally)

trigger.text: When you make repairs to your vehicles or other mechanical devices...

resupply.name: Resupply

miss.text: On a __miss__, you encounter an unexpected peril. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text:
On a __strong hit__, choose one.

  * If you are unprepared, clear the impact and take +1 supply. Otherwise, take +2 supply.
  * If you are in need of a specific item or resource that can reasonably be obtained, you acquire it. Take +1 momentum.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you must first deal with a cost, complication, or demand. Envision the nature of this obstacle.

Then choose one.

  * If you are unprepared, clear the impact and take +1 supply. Otherwise, take +2 supply.
  * If you are in need of a specific item or resource that can reasonably be obtained, you acquire it. Take +1 momentum.

resupply.text:
__When you attempt to bolster your readiness__, envision the opportunity and your approach. If you...

  * Barter or make an appeal: Roll +heart
  * Scavenge or craft: Roll +wits
  * Threaten or seize: Roll +iron
  * Steal or swindle: Roll +dark

On a __strong hit__, choose one.

  * If you are unprepared, clear the impact and take +1 supply. Otherwise, take +2 supply.
  * If you are in need of a specific item or resource that can reasonably be obtained, you acquire it. Take +1 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but you must first deal with a cost, complication, or demand. Envision the nature of this obstacle.

On a __miss__, you encounter an unexpected peril. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you attempt to bolster your readiness...

sojourn.name: Sojourn

miss.text:
On a __miss__, choose one.

  * The community needs your help, or makes a costly demand in exchange for your safety. Envision what they ask of you. If you do it, or [Make a Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/make_a_plan) to see it done, resolve this move as a strong hit.
  * You find no relief, and the situation grows worse. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, this is a safe refuge. You and your allies may each choose two recover moves: [Heal](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/heal), [Hearten](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/hearten), [Repair](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/repair), or [Resupply](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/resupply). Instead of rolling, assume an automatic strong hit for each. An individual move can be taken more than once. If you use the __Radiation__ meter, take +1 radiation additionally.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, this is a safe refuge, but time is short or resources are strained. You and your allies may each make one recover move (with no more than three moves total among the group): [Heal](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/heal), [Hearten](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/hearten), [Repair](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/repair), or [Resupply](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/resupply). Instead of rolling, assume an automatic strong hit for each. An individual move can be taken more than once.

sojourn.text:
__When you spend time recovering within a community__, roll +heart.

On a __strong hit__, this is a safe refuge. You and your allies may each choose two recover moves: [Heal](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/heal), [Hearten](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/hearten), [Repair](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/repair), or [Resupply](datasworn:move:revenant/recover/resupply). Instead of rolling, assume an automatic strong hit for each. An individual move can be taken more than once. If you use the __Radiation__ meter, take +1 radiation additionally.

On a __weak hit__, as above, but time is short or resources are strained. You and your allies each make one recover move instead of two, with no more than three moves total among the group.

On a __miss__, choose one.

  * The community needs your help, or makes a costly demand in exchange for your safety. Envision what they ask of you. If you do it, or [Make a Plan](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/make_a_plan) to see it done, resolve this move as a strong hit.
  * You find no relief, and the situation grows worse. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When you spend time recovering within a community...

recover.description:
When your resources are strained, your endurance and morale are ebbing, and your equipment and vehicles in disrepair, you'll need to find relief from the constant hardships of the world.

Make these __recover moves__ when you attempt to rest, recover, or restock.
recover.name: Recover Moves
recover.summary: __Recover moves__ are for resting and recuperating.

begin_the_scene.name: Begin the Scene
begin_the_scene.text:
__When you face an extended or complex challenge__, name your objective and choose a rank as appropriate to the situation.

  * You have a clear advantage: Troublesome
  * You are ready to act: Dangerous
  * You are unprepared or outmatched: Formidable

Then, activate a tension clock.

trigger.text: When you face an extended or complex challenge...

finish_the_scene.name: Finish the Scene

miss.text: On a __miss__, you fail, or are undermined by a dramatic and costly turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you achieve your objective unconditionally.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you succeed, but not without cost. You must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster) but, you can make this a minor cost relative to the scope of the scene.

finish_the_scene.text:
__When the scene challenge tension clock or progress track is filled, or when events lead to the scene's conclusion__, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.

On a __strong hit__, you achieve your objective unconditionally.

On a __weak hit__, you succeed, but not without cost. You must [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster) but, you can make this a minor cost relative to the scope of the scene.

On a __miss__, you fail or are undermined by a dire and costly turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster).

trigger.text: When the scene challenge tension clock or progress track is filled, or when events lead to the scene's conclusion...

obtain_an_opportunity.name: Obtain an Opportunity

miss.text: On a __miss__, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster) and fill a clock segment. On a __miss with a match__, fill two segments instead.

strong_hit.text:
On a __strong hit__, you are successful. Take +2 momentum and add +1 on your next move (not a progress move).

 On a __strong hit with a match__, take both and mark progress.

weak_hit.text:
On a __weak hit__, you are successful. Choose one.

  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

obtain_an_opportunity.text:
__When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage within a scene challenge__, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  * With finesse, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
  * With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
  * With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
  * With deception, stealth, or betrayal: Roll +dark
  * With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

On a __hit__, you are successful. On a __strong hit__, take both. On a __strong hit with a match__, take both and mark progress. On a __weak hit__, choose one.

  * Take +2 momentum
  * Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

On a __miss__, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster) and fill a clock segment. On a __miss with a match__, fill two segments instead.

trigger.text: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage within a scene challenge...

overcome_peril.name: Overcome Peril

miss.text: On a __miss__, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster) and fill a clock segment. On a __miss with a match__, fill two segments instead.

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, you are successful and mark progress. On a __strong hit with a match__, mark progress twice.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, you are successful and mark progress, but also encounter a complication or setback. Envision what occurs and fill a clock segment.

overcome_peril.text:
__When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat within a scene challenge__, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  * With finesse, mobility, or agility: Roll +edge
  * With resolve, command, or sociability: Roll +heart
  * With strength, endurance, or aggression: Roll +iron
  * With deception, stealth, or betrayal: Roll +dark
  * With expertise, focus, or observation: Roll +wits

On a __strong hit__, you are successful and mark progress. On a __strong hit with a match__, mark progress twice.

On a __weak hit__, you are successful and mark progress, but also encounter a complication or setback. Envision what occurs and fill a clock segment.

On a __miss__, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. [Meet with Disaster](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/meet_with_disaster) and fill a clock segment. On a __miss with a match__, fill two segments instead.

trigger.text: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat within a scene challenge...

scene_challenge.description: A __scene challenge__ is a structured approach for resolving an extended non-combat scene against a threat or other characters, particularly when a time limit or looming danger adds extra urgency. Examples of a scene challenge include barricading a warehouse against an oncoming horde of zombies, participating in a debate, or competing in an off-road race.
scene_challenge.name: Scene Challenges
scene_challenge.summary: __Scene moves__ are for extended non-combat situations.

begin_a_session.name: Begin a Session

rows.text: Flashback reveals an aspect of a character's background
Flashback reveals an aspect of another place, or faction
A character or faction is introduced or given new detail
Unrelated situations are shown to be connected
External danger, urgency, or new importance for a plan
Important character is put in danger
Key location is made unsafe or becomes mired in conflict
Unexpected return of an enemy or threat
Peril lies ahead or lurks just out of view
Unforeseen aid is on the way or within reach

begin_a_session.text:
__When you begin a significant session or chapter of play__, do all of the following.

  * Identify or adjust flagged content and [Set a Flag](datasworn:move:revenant/session/set_a_flag).
  * Review or recap what happened last session.
  * Set the scene by envisioning all of the player character's current situation and intent.

In addition, you may spotlight a new danger, opportunity, or insight. This can include a scene hidden from your character's perspective. If you do, envision a brief vignette (you may roll or choose on the table below for inspiration). Then, all players take +1 momentum as you return to play from the viewpoint of your characters.

{{table>move.oracle_rollable:revenant/session/begin_a_session.begin_a_session}}

trigger.text: When you begin a significant session or chapter of play...

change_your_fate.name: Change Your Fate
change_your_fate.text:
__When you encounter flagged content, reject an oracle, resist a consequence, or otherwise need to shift your circumstances within the game for your comfort or enjoyment__, pause and identify what needs to be changed. Choose as many options as appropriate.

  * __Reframe:__ This didn't happen the way you first thought. Envision the moment from another perspective in a way that diminishes or changes the content.
  * __Refocus:__ This is not the most important thing happening right now. Envision how the spotlight shifts to change the focus.
  * __Replace:__ This happens but with a small adjustment. Switch out an element and envision how this new detail changes the scenario.
  * __Redirect:__ Adjust the trajectory to involve a helping hand. Envision how another person or party becomes involved.
  * __Reshape:__ The situation changes completely. Envision what happened instead.

trigger.text: When you encounter flagged content, reject an oracle, resist a consequence, or otherwise need to shift your circumstances within the game for your comfort or enjoyment...

end_a_session.name: End a Session
end_a_session.text:
__When you end a significant session or chapter of play__, reflect on the events of the game and identify any missed opportunities to mark progress.

  * If you strengthened your ties to a connection, [Develop Your Relationship](datasworn:move:revenant/connection/develop_your_relationship).
  * If you moved forward on a quest, [Reach a Milestone](datasworn:move:revenant/plan/reach_a_milestone).
  * If there is a plan, connection, or other situation you would like to give focus in your next session, make note of it and take +1 momentum.

trigger.text: When you end a significant session or chapter of play...

set_a_flag.name: Set a Flag
set_a_flag.text:
__When you identify situations or topics you don't want to include, don't want to envision in detail, or otherwise may need mindfulness when approaching__, that content is now flagged.

When you encounter content flagged as something to approach mindfully, pause to consider or discuss its role in your story. When you come across flagged content that you would rather adjust or omit, [Change Your Fate](datasworn:move:revenant/session/change_your_fate).

trigger.text: When you identify situations or topics you don't want to include, don't want to envision in detail, or otherwise may need mindfulness when approaching...

take_a_break.name: Take a Break
take_a_break.text:
__When you resolve a progress move or complete an intense scenario__, take a few deep breaths and take some time to attend to the needs of your body. Reflect on what just happened and how it made you feel. Then, choose one.

  * Move on: Continue the session. You or an ally may add +1 on the next move (not a progress move), bolstered by your reflection and past experiences.
  * Stop for now: [End a Session](datasworn:move:revenant/session/end_a_session).

trigger.text: When you resolve a progress move or complete an intense scenario...

session.description:
_Session Moves_ are used to set boundaries of what content can be included in your game and adjust the content as you play. They are also used to frame the start and finish of your game and to provide a space to take a break from *Revenant*. They are intended for all modes of play.

Unlike other moves, the session moves are written from the perspective of the players rather than the character. They are a tool to facilitate and moderate a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone at your game.
session.name: Session Moves
session.summary: __Session moves__ are used to start and finish the time you have to play. They also ensure the content is managed in a way that does not cause distress.

companion_takes_a_hit.name: Companion Takes a Hit

miss.text: On a __miss__, it's worse than you thought. They suffer an additional -1 endurance or you [Lose Momentum](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/lose_momentum) (-1). If your companion's endurance is 0, they are out of action until given aid. If their endurance is 0 and you rolled a miss with a match on this move, they are dead; clear the connection.

strong_hit.text: On a __strong hit__, your companion rallies. Give them +1 endurance.

weak_hit.text: On a __weak hit__, if your companion's endurance is not 0, you may [Lose Momentum](datasworn:move:revenant/suffer/lose_momentum) (-1) and give them +1 endurance. Otherwise, they press on.

companion_takes_a_hit.text:

suffer.description:
These moves are made as a result of a perilous event or bad outcome on other moves. They represent what happens to you, and how you hold up against the trauma.

Making a __suffer move__ is not, however, the only possible outcome of a failure. You might face story complications or new dangers. You might lose an important item. Your relationship with another character might be tested. When in doubt, [Seek Guidance](datasworn:move:revenant/fate/seek_guidance).

When you suffer harm at the hands of an NPC in combat, you will use their rank to determine the amount by which your meter will be reduced. See page 218 for more information on NPC ranks.
suffer.name: Suffer Moves
suffer.summary: __Suffer moves__ occur when you endure hardship, such as suffering physical harm or facing a demoralising event. It also covers character death and desolation.

anaconda.description:
The name anaconda applies to a group of snakes, but it is often used to refer to only one species, the green anaconda. The green anaconda is also known as the giant emerald anaconda, common anaconda or common water boa, and is the largest and heaviest snake in the world. There are reports of anacondas reaching over 5 meters in length and a typical adult weighs between 30 and 80 kilograms.

While the anaconda is native to the Amazon and Orinoco basins of South America they have been observed in the wild in Florida. They are slow on land but stealthy in the water and as such they live in swamps and rivers in tropical rainforests and seasonally flooded savannahs. With eyes and nasal openings on the top of their heads, they can lie in wait for prey while remaining nearly completely submerged.
anaconda.name: Anaconda

brown_bear.description:
Brown bears are found across Eurasia and North America and are recognised as a national and state animal in several European countries. They commonly weigh up to 600 kilograms and, when standing fully upright on their hindlegs, can be over 3 meters tall. The brown bears strength has been estimated at 2.5 to 5 times that of a human.

They are one of the most omnivorous animals in the world and consume the greatest variety of foods of any bear. They are regularly curious about the potential of eating virtually anything they encounter. Their jaw structure has evolved to fit this dietary habit.

Brown bears love to eat carrion and, as long as the Revenant pathogen is unable to infect them, they would quickly learn that zombies make for good eating. Brown bears are not afraid of humans and have long, sharp claws designed for rolling over logs. They are more than capable of tearing zombies limb from limb before they pose any threat to the bear.
brown_bear.name: Brown Bear

buck.description:
Most deer populations require constant hunting or culling and are known to cause crop damage and stop forestry regeneration. The deer population in an area only typically limits itself naturally through disease and starvation.

Historically, people have hunted animals and found new and inventive ways of using every part of the animal with little to no waste. Deer make excellent animals to hunt because, apart from the meat, their hides are useful for making clothing and carrying bags. Their antlers can be used for making tool and knife handles. Their bones can be used to create tools that work as well as their metal counterparts such as needles, fish hooks or arrowheads. The fat of the deer can also be used to create soap and candles.
buck.name: Buck

cougar.description:
Cougars, often called the puma, panther, or mountain lion, are large cats native to north and south America. They are solitary by nature and stand almost 1 meter tall and generally weigh up to 70 kilograms. Cougars get smaller the closer to the poles.

Unlike other big cat man-eaters, cougars do not kill humans as a result of old age, but in defense of territory. Most attacks are in late spring and summer when juvenile cougars leave their mothers and search for new territory. Such behaviours has been documented in hunts, where a cougar is flushed out by dogs—which it is capable of outrunning. Then, the cougar circles around and mauls the hunter in an ambush attack.
cougar.name: Cougar

crocodile.description:
Zombies are very capable grapplers and are able to latch on to prey. However, they lack the strength and fine motor skills for swimming and crossing fast running water. A zombie's limited movement means they have difficulty getting themselves out of mud or deep water. Any animals in the region that are capable of being infected by the Revenant pathogen may not even need to be bitten.

Whether the creatures in the aquatic environment can become zombies or not, the decay from the great number of undead in the waters would have a detrimental effect on the ecosystem. In these cases crocodiles would prey upon living humans more aggressively than they do presently if they are unable to source other food. However, crocodiles are also not beyond consuming carrion and would easily digest zombie flesh.
crocodile.name: Crocodile

lion.description:
While the lion is only native to Africa and India there are numerous zoos across the world that hold these animals as specimens. In the early days of an apocalypse, lions could be set free by their keepers who do not wish to see them starve in captivity. However, in the later days of the apocalypse their numbers will be limited where they are not native due to having a limited or non-existent breeding pool.

Lions generally sleep for 20 hours a day and are continuously trying to keep cool. If there is a cataclysm that causes a global temperature drop, lions would actually become more active as long as they can find food. In a region that has a deer population, this would be very easy.

While a human wouldn't typically be a lions first choice of prey, they are fiercely territorial and would kill to defend themselves or their cubs. They would also attack humans if they were starving.
lion.name: Lion

piranha.description:
Piranha are a tropical freshwater fish native to South America but they can survive in waters as low as 10 degrees celcius for brief periods. When in colder water they feed less and are unable to digest their food. However, when the water begins to warm up even slightly they become more aggressive as they will be ravenous.

Contrary to popular belief, piranhas are not capable of stripping a human to the bone in seconds and prefer smaller food or carrion. It is for this reason that people may release a large number of these fish into waterways that could become blocked with the undead. However, if the piranha decimated the other aquatic population, they would attack anything that wander into the water.

Piranha have one of the strongest bites and, relative to body mass, the black piranha produces one of the most forceful bites measured among invertebrates. Although piranhas often attack as individuals, piranha only swim in large numbers to avoid other predators.
piranha.name: Piranha

rats.description:
Rats will do everything in their power to escape a creature larger than them. But, if there is no way to escape, a cornered rat would not hesitate to attack a human. The last-ditch response of a rat to any threat it can't run away from is to go absolutely berserk, shrieking and snapping its teeth audibly while leaping up to 70cm into the air.

While a lone rat may not normally pose any challenge in combat, the stakes are high if it is capable of transmitting the Revenant pathogen.

Rats are notorious for eating anything and having an incredible immune system. The fleas on rats were responsible for the black plague of the 14th century. It was discovered that fleas that had contracted the Yersina pestis bacterium—that caused the bubonic plague—would have an obstruction in their midgut. The obstruction would be purged through overfeeding and regurgitation. This resulted in thousands of the Y. Pestis to flush into the feeding site, infecting the host.

The bubonic plague was so impactful due to the mechanism upon which it was dependant. Rats were immune to the disease, allowing for them to become hosts and spread the disease throughout Europe. Humans lacked that resistance to the disease. When the infected humans died, the fleas would move onto a new host, thus creating a human epidemic.

In a zombie apocalypse it's entirely possible that rats could even feed upon the reanimated dead and contract the Revenant pathogen. When you fight an enemy that has been infected, you will need to [Avoid Being Bitten](datasworn:move:revenant/combat/avoid_being_bitten) (see p. 226).
rats.name: Rats

wild_dogs.description:
In an apocalypse there would be many dogs left behind in cities as their owners are evacuated or killed. These dogs would quickly break free and form packs. While some of the smaller dog species would fall prey to the other dogs, the more resourceful of them would find their way into small spaces to escape danger and be able to access food that the larger dogs would have trouble reaching. This would ingratiate them into existing packs and secure their safety.

Some of these dogs will have no fear of humans as other animals do and would eagerly run down a lone human or a few vulnerable travellers. However, dogs are bred throughout history to be domesticated and could become so again. A person willing to take the time and the risk with domesticating a dog could be rewarded with a loyal companion.
wild_dogs.name: Wild Dogs
tactics: Use prior training to an advantage

wolf.description:
Animals typically work on instincts developed over hundreds of thousands of years of evolution. Zombies do not match any of these pre-programmed responses designed to determine the proper reaction to any situation relevant to the animal's natural habitat. In the event there is no proper response, the final instinct kicks in - run! However, animals are highly capable of learning routines and survival tactics. In an apocalypse, the zombies would relentlessly follow fleeing wolves. The wolf's only tactic would be to go on the offensive and attack.

Adult wolves stand almost 1 meter tall and weigh upwards of 40 kilograms with wolves growing larger the further north they live. They would have no trouble facing off against a few of the undead and their thick fur would protect them from even the most savage of human bites. Although wolves usually only kill when they are hungry, wolves have been known to kill when prey are vulnerable and easy to catch. When this happens they may return later to feed on the carcass, or they may leave it to scavengers. It is entirely possible that wolves could learn to cache food for the roaming undead to ensure they are not followed to their dens.
wolf.name: Wolf

pack_of_wolves.name: Pack of Wolves

cannibal.description:
Without food, people can be driven to desperate acts. Cannibals prey on other humans for food. However, the skeletal flesh of a human contains only a meagre 32,000 calories. Assuming the minimum daily requirement of 2,400 calories per adult, one person would barely provide a days calorie needs for dozen cannibals. In post-apocalyptic times when daily exertion is greater and calorie needs higher, a single human body would stretch for much less.

It is because of this that cannibals are only found on their own or in very small groups, such as; an elderly couple in a run-down diner who drug some of their visitors to keep meat in the pies; an extended family of degenerate savages who eat whatever or whoever they can catch; or, a small town that seems wholesome enough until you learn the punishment for breaking their strict laws is forfeitting your choice of limb.
cannibal.name: Cannibal
tactics: Find a weakness and exploit it

hunter.description:
When the looting started in the cities people with firearms were able to retain the most of their possessions. Anywhere that sold firearms was overrun with people trying to take whatever they could to make it on their own. People that were shot and killed in the riots who had been hiding bites reanimated shortly afterwards as zombies and made those places hotspots for infestations.

During the first few months of the Fall, inexperienced hunters found a temporary solution within the confines of abandoned farms. These forsaken agricultural havens became a reliable source of sustenance, harboring domesticated animals that had been left to fend for themselves in the wake of societal collapse.

Among the livestock, most of the cattle were dairy cows rather than their beef counterparts. The significance lay in the nature of dairy cows: if not milked regularly, typically within a week, they faced the risk of falling ill. With the absence of human caretakers, these once- productive creatures became vulnerable to both the unforgiving reality of the post-apocalyptic world and the imminent threat of disease. As a result, a considerable number of these dairy cows were culled. The beef cattle and other sizable domesticated animals faced an insurmountable challenge during the Ash. The ability to feed these larger animals became impossible, and regrettably, many were also culled as a harsh but pragmatic measure.

As the remnants of abandoned farms were gradually exhausted of their domesticated inhabitants, the focus of the hunters shifted toward the untamed wilderness. Now, the hunted prey primarily consisted of wild animals, as survivors adapted their strategies to the unpredictable challenges of hunting in the open, post-apocalyptic landscape. The shift from contained, domesticated animals to elusive and unpredictable wild game marked a transition in the survival tactics of the remaining human population, reflecting the evolving dynamics of their struggle for sustenance in a world forever altered by catastrophe.
features: Grizzled and at home in the wild

lmoe.description: The Last Man On Earth, often abbreviated to L.M.O.E or called an Elmo, is a type of wasteland warrior that doesn't want to rejoin society. They've carved out a decent piece of the world for themselves and they'll be damned if anyone is coming to take it from them. Most of them have a decent arsenal of salvaged gear and the skills to use it.
lmoe.name: L.M.O.E

outcast.description:
People who have commited serious crimes against their community are cast out into the wastelands. These outcasts start their own groups and often can only survive by seizing what they need from others. Sometimes these people merely become highwaymen or bandits that do what they must to get by on their own. Others, however, relish the freedom to do what they want upon the helpless inhabitants of the wastelands.

The larger groups generally unite under the most extreme or ferocious warriors among them. These warlords hold great power and attract other militant zealots and power hungry followers. They have such a control over their domain that a warlord's presence is known through their diehard followers before they themselves are seen.

ranger.description:
After the people who fled the cities had pillaged the farmlands and the supplies they had taken with them were spent, they needed to return to the cities. The undead had formed hordes that congested the streets and others had become trapped in cars or buildings. Scavenging was a dangerous but essential task. In the safe areas, enclaves were established and fortified. They became centres for trade and havens for travellers but they also became targets for the raiders.

Anywhere the raiders settled would disrupt trade and, because the economy was directed at only the most basic subsistence, the enclaves that relied purely on trade would fail. Soon enclaves started forming bands of warriors called Rangers who would defend the regions.

Enclaves that had set up in the wilderness were thriving. They had left the concreted earth and found arable land. They produced their own food, clothing, and shelter. However, some of them had been responsible for enabling raids on other enclaves by providing the outcasts with food and supplies in return for protection.

The Rangers endeavoured to establish a standing army to defend the enclaves that uphold some semblance of law and order.

Those enclaves lucky enough to have a garrison of Rangers were fast growing and soon became economic hubs of their region. These hubs attracted a variety of people and, without reliable identification processes, any number of people cast out of their own enclaves also found a place to hide out in plain sight.
ranger.name: Ranger

scavenger.description: People brave or desperate enough to risk venturing into the cities and other resource-rich areas claim the title of Scavenger with pride. They have an uncanny luck of finding the best gear in the best condition and can access the most hidden places. They are capable of remaining undetected and often have enough provisions to hide out for days if not weeks. Scavengers are often willing to help or trade supplies for the right price.
scavenger.name: Scavenger

technician.description: During the Uprising many people with science qualifications were selected under the mandates to form into teams. These specialists were given basic combat and survival training in the field. Many of these teams held, and now maintain, strategic positions to ensure disasters are avoided or essential services are kept operational for local enclaves. The role of Technician in the Post-Ash is a role revered by many and even the most violent warlord will not only allow but will ensure safe passage through their claimed territory.
